Scale: the plate spans about 440 px in the image. If it is a standard 26 cm dinner plate, that gives roughly 0.06 cm per px, or about 17 px per cm.

Mashed sweet potato: about 130×130 px, so roughly 7.5×7.5 cm and about 3 cm high. That is about 90 cm³ at a density of about 1 g/cm³, so around 130 g.

Tuna salad: about 200×230 px, so roughly 11×13 cm and about 3 cm high. Allowing for it being irregular, the volume is about 150 cm³, so I estimate 140 g.

Shredded carrot: about 190×230 px, so roughly 11×13 cm and about 2.5 cm high. It is loose and airy, with a density of about 0.45 g/cm³. That gives about 100 g.
